workflow.invalidReferences: Check reference titles and HTTP(S) URLs.
workflow.invalidDate: Invalid time, outside the allowed dates, or ambiguous/nonexistent due to daylight saving time.

errors.generic: Unable to complete this action. Please try again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your workspace role cannot perform this action.
errors.WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED: You no longer have access to this workspace.
errors.TASK_NOT_FOUND: Task not found in this workspace.
errors.CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND: Unable to verify the linked campaign.
errors.TASK_REVISION_CONFLICT: This task changed. Your input is retained; loading the latest version discards unsaved input.
errors.TASK_WORKFLOW_LOCKED: Work has started or ended. Requirements and assignment are locked.
errors.TASK_START_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED: This legacy task has unverified start history. It remains readable; review its data before editing or assignment.
errors.TASK_CAMPAIGN_COMPLETED: The campaign is complete. Editing, reassignment and starting work are locked.
errors.TASK_SCHEMA_NOT_READY: Run the Task workflow foundation migration before saving or assigning. Reading remains available.
errors.TASK_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Task storage is temporarily unavailable. Reload to check before retrying.
errors.TASK_TRANSACTIONS_UNAVAILABLE: MongoDB transactions required for this action are unavailable.
errors.INVALID_ASSIGNEE: The assignee must be an active creator in this workspace.
errors.INVALID_QC_ASSIGNEE: The quality reviewer must be an active creator in this workspace.
errors.QC_CANNOT_BE_SAME_AS_ASSIGNEE: The quality reviewer must differ from the assignee.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Check the fields below.
